svg.title: File Compare mouse navigation
svg.desc: Normal text clicks set the caret and active difference. Shift and double clicks retain text selection. Control click resolves a definition in that snapshot; Control Shift click lists literal occurrences. Result text changes only through explicit merge or edit actions.

g.text: Mouse navigation in either source snapshot
Definition in this version + navigation history
These source gestures preserve Result text and its Undo history.
